about: Experience Kingdom of Paradise originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
A fragile peace shatters… an ancient enemy awakes…

The alliance of the five ruling clans has been betrayed and the kingdom of Ouka is in turmoil. An outcast swordsman, one of the last of his clan, must unlock secrets once thought lost and restore harmony to the land.
Embark on an epic action RPG featuring more than 20 hours of adventure and utilise countless sword-wielding combinations to create a customised martial arts style.

This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Kingdom of Paradise originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
